The '''Sathari''' were a reclusive [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Bird/Legends|avian]] [[Species/Legends|species]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Arbooine/Legends|Arbooine]]. The species possessed hand-tipped wings capable of manipulating tools. The avians lived mostly in small settlements in the forest canopy of their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]].

==Appearances==
*''[[Chronicles of the Gatekeeper]]'' {{1st}}
